ValidationRule.description: Epoch seconds must agree with Kickoff At (year, hour, 5-minute grid, no stale midnight), durations must render with day units, standup times must sit in a lunch-free window, and active kickoffs cannot be in the future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Epoch_Seconds__c)), OR( ABS(UNIXTIMESTAMP(Kickoff_At__c) - Epoch_Seconds__c) > 3600, YEAR(DATEVALUE(FROMUNIXTIME(Epoch_Seconds__c))) <> YEAR(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)), IF( FROMUNIXTIME(Epoch_Seconds__c) > NOW() + 3650, TRUE, DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) & ' 00:00:00') > Kickoff_At__c ) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Active'), OR( Kickoff_At__c > NOW() + 1, AND(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c) = TODAY(), TIMEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c) > TIMENOW()), MOD(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)), 5) + SECOND(TIMEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) + MILLISECOND(TIMEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) > 0 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_Secs__c)), OR( Duration_Secs__c < 0, AND(Duration_Secs__c >= 86400, NOT(CONTAINS(FORMATDURATION(Duration_Secs__c, TRUE), 'd'))), CEILING(Duration_Secs__c / 86400) > NULLVALUE(End_Date__c - Start_Date__c, 9999) + 1 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Standup_Time__c)), OR( Standup_Time__c < TIMEVALUE('06:00:00.000'), HOUR(Standup_Time__c) >= 20, AND(HOUR(Standup_Time__c) = 12, MINUTE(Standup_Time__c) < 30) ) ) ) )
